summary: Joby Aviation filed an 8-K reporting a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement covering the resale of 2,419,801 shares of common stock issued to a selling stockholder upon achievement of EBITDA milestones tied to its prior acquisition of the passenger segment and operations of Strata Critical Medical, Inc. (formerly Blade Air Mobility). The shares form part of Joby's existing Form S-3 shelf (No. 333-282809). Latham & Watkins' validity opinion is filed as Exhibit 5.1. No price, premium, or new deal terms are stated; this is an ordinary milestone share resale registration with possible overhang.
